title: InsightSeg: Reusing Correction Insights for Guideline-Consistent Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.02002v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Guideline-consistent semantic segmentation requires more than category recognition, as real-world labeling policies demand fine-grained, task-specific decisions. Recent multi-agent refinement systems improve compliance with such textual guidelines by detecting and correcting errors. However, they are stateless: feedback from the critiquing agent is discarded, causing the same guideline-specific mistakes to be repeatedly rediscovered and corrected across the dataset at the cost of additional refinement. We introduce InsightSeg, an episodic memory mechanism that converts successful correction episodes into reusable, visually grounded insights. A meta-analyzer distills each qualifying episode into directive natural-language insights and anchors them to the local image regions that caused the error using patch-level visual concept vectors. translated_title: InsightSeg：复用纠正洞察以实现符合标注准则的分割
translated_abstract: 符合标注准则的语义分割所需要的不仅仅是类别识别，因为现实世界的标注政策要求做出细粒度的、任务特定的决策。最近的多智能体精修系统通过检测和纠正错误来提高对此类文本准则的遵从性。然而，这些系统是无状态的：来自批评智能体的反馈会被丢弃，导致同样的准则相关错误在整个数据集上被反复重新发现和纠正，付出了额外的精修代价。我们提出了 InsightSeg，这是一种情景记忆机制，能够将成功的纠正过程转化为可复用的、视觉锚定的洞察。元分析器将每个符合条件的纠正过程提炼为指令性的自然语言洞察，并使用块级视觉概念向量将其锚定到引发错误的局部图像区域。在后续图像上，这些概念会与稠密的块嵌入进行匹配，以检索相关的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 InsightSeg，一种情景记忆机制，可将成功的错误纠正过程提炼为与局部图像区域锚定的可复用视觉洞察，从而在符合标注准则的语义分割中避免在数据集上重复发现和纠正相同的错误。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces InsightSeg, an episodic memory mechanism that distills successful correction episodes into reusable, visually grounded insights anchored to error-causing image regions, enabling guideline-consistent segmentation without repeatedly rediscovering and correcting the same mistakes across the dataset.
